mapper.sql: employee_calendars.id AS id, employee_calendars.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.code AS employeeCode, employees.name AS employeeName, departments.name AS departmentName, employee_calendars.date_from AS dateFrom, employee_calendars.date_to AS dateTo, employee_calendars.is_repeatable AS isRepeatable, employee_calendars.repeat_type AS repeatType, employee_calendars.description AS description, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT employee_calendar_details.repeat_days ORDER BY FIELD( employee_calendar_details.repeat_days, 'Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM employee_calendar_details WHERE employee_calendar_details.employee_calendar_id = employee_calendars.id AND employee_calendar_details.repeat_days IS NOT NULL AND employee_calendar_details.repeat_days != '' ) AS repeatDays, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT customer_markets.name ORDER BY customer_markets.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM employee_calendar_details INNER JOIN customer_markets ON customer_markets.id = employee_calendar_details.market_id WHERE employee_calendar_details.employee_calendar_id = employee_calendars.id AND customer_markets.is_active = 1 ) AS marketNames, employee_calendars.created AS created, employee_calendars.modified AS modified, CONCAT(user1.first_name, ' ', user1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(user2.first_name, ' ', user2.last_name) AS modifiedBy, employee_calendars.is_active AS isActive

FROM employee_calendars LEFT JOIN employees ON employee_calendars.employee_id = employees.id LEFT JOIN departments ON departments.id = employees.department_id LEFT JOIN users AS user1 ON employee_calendars.created_by = user1.id LEFT JOIN users AS user2 ON employee_calendars.modified_by = user2.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_calendars ( employee_id, is_repeatable, repeat_type, date_from, date_to, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{employeeCalendar.employeeId}, #{employeeCalendar.isRepeatable}, #{employeeCalendar.repeatType}, #{employeeCalendar.dateFrom}, #{employeeCalendar.dateTo}, #{employeeCalendar.description}, NOW(), #{employeeCalendar.createdBy}, #{employeeCalendar.isActive} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT market_id FROM employee_calendar_details WHERE employee_calendar_id = #{employeeCalendarId} AND market_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY market_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT repeat_days FROM employee_calendar_details WHERE employee_calendar_id = #{employeeCalendarId} AND repeat_days IS NOT NULL AND repeat_days != '' ORDER BY FIELD(repeat_days, 'Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday')
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_calendars SET employee_id = #{employeeCalendar.employeeId}, is_repeatable = #{employeeCalendar.isRepeatable}, repeat_type = #{employeeCalendar.repeatType}, date_from = #{employeeCalendar.dateFrom}, date_to = #{employeeCalendar.dateTo}, description = #{employeeCalendar.description}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{employeeCalendar.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{employeeCalendar.id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.delete: UPDATE employee_calendars SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
